home.eyebrow: African coordination for maritime decarbonisation and climate governance
home.h1: A professional African platform for evidence, convening, and public influence
home.intro: PATNA helps African experts, institutions, and public-interest partners turn technical evidence into coordinated positions, regional convenings, and implementation-ready strategy.
home.storyTitle: An institutional home for African evidence and coordination
home.missionPara1: PATNA works at the intersection of technical analysis, diplomatic alignment, and implementation strategy so African actors can shape global maritime transition decisions with greater confidence.
home.missionPara2: What began as LEAP — a targeted effort to equip six African states with independent, data-driven analysis for IMO negotiations — has evolved into a permanent, institutionalised Pan-African secretariat. In 2026, PATNA operates as the in-continent partner under the Shipping Decarbonisation Africa Regional Workplan, in partnership with the UCL Energy Institute.
home.pullQuote: To amplify Africa's voice in global maritime decarbonisation through coordinated, evidence-based engagement — ensuring that international frameworks reflect Africa's realities, constraints, and aspirations.
home.maritimeContext: 90% of Africa's trade is seaborne. Africa cannot afford to be a bystander in the decisions shaping its transition.
home.heroVisualBody: PATNA's public record is grounded in working sessions, summits, and technical dialogue where African priorities are shaped in practice.
home.contextTitle: The transition challenge is continental and practical
home.contextBody: Beyond high-level convenings, PATNA's work speaks to ports, shipping systems, and implementation realities across African economies.
home.capabilityEvidenceBody: PATNA translates complex technical questions into analysis, briefs, and decision-ready material grounded in African realities.
home.capabilityConveningBody: The network brings together policymakers, researchers, and practitioners to build stronger coordinated African positions.
home.capabilityImplementationBody: PATNA connects global maritime decisions to port readiness, institutional planning, and long-term implementation pathways.

about.label: About PATNA
about.subtitle: PATNA is a registered non-profit secretariat dedicated to amplifying Africa's voice in global maritime decarbonisation through coordinated, evidence-based engagement — ensuring international frameworks reflect Africa's realities, constraints, and aspirations.
about.title: Africa-centred evidence, diplomacy, and institutional coordination
about.whoTitle: A pan-African network built for long-term public influence
about.whoSubtitle: PATNA emerged from the recognition that African perspectives were too often under-represented in global maritime and climate processes, despite the continent bearing major economic and social consequences.
about.whoPara1: What began as a small group of African experts engaging the International Maritime Organization (IMO) has grown into a permanent, institutionalised Pan-African secretariat — Africa's dedicated hub of maritime, energy, and climate expertise. PATNA bridges disciplines, languages, and regions so African realities can inform global climate and energy outcomes.
about.whoPara2: Operating through a structured cohort model across academic, policy, industry, and civil society streams, PATNA serves as a trusted intermediary between world-class research institutions and African delegations — translating complex regulatory proposals into decision-ready briefings for national capitals and IMO negotiators.
about.visionText: To be the leading coalition of African technical experts advancing innovative, inclusive, and Africa-centred solutions for climate action and energy transition across interconnected systems.
about.missionText: To amplify Africa's voice in global maritime decarbonisation through coordinated, evidence-based engagement — ensuring that international frameworks reflect Africa's realities, constraints, and aspirations.
about.orgTitle: Four core constituencies shape PATNA's public community
about.orgSubtitle: PATNA's work is strengthened by a mix of researchers, policymakers, industry practitioners, and civil society leaders.
about.journeyTitle: From LEAP to a permanent Pan-African secretariat
about.journeySubtitle: PATNA did not emerge fully formed. Each phase has built irreversibly on the last — the evidence of Phase I informed the modelling of Phase II, and the networks forged in Dakar now underpin the diplomatic coordination of Phase III.
about.pillarsSubtitle: Each pillar represents both a strategic commitment and an operational programme of work — with measurable outcomes, dedicated Working Groups, and a data architecture designed to demonstrate impact over time.
about.uclBody: The partnership between the PATNA Initiative and the UCL Energy Institute is the technical backbone of Africa's most rigorous maritime decarbonisation programme. UCL's Shipping and Oceans Research Group brings advanced data analytics, cutting-edge modelling, and decades of policy-influencing research to PATNA's Africa-centred agenda. Under the 2026 Shipping Decarbonisation Africa Regional Workplan, UCL provides technical research capacity, modelling support, and AIS data, while PATNA leads in-continent coordination, diplomatic engagement, stakeholder mobilisation, and community governance.
about.wgTitle: Six working groups anchor PATNA's Phase III programme
about.wgSubtitle: Each Working Group connects technical research to specific IMO decision windows, ensuring PATNA's outputs are grounded in African priorities and delivered on time.
about.stratSubtitle: PATNA's most urgent work is ensuring that Africa's evidence, positions, and voices shape IMO Net Zero Framework implementation guidelines while they are still being designed.
about.stratImperative1Title: Influence IMO guidelines before they become fixed
about.stratImperative1Body: Critical implementation details — ZNZ reward mechanisms, fund governance, certification standards, revenue distribution — must be shaped by Africa's evidence and positions between 2026 and 2028.
about.stratImperative2Body: The Fellowship Programme, Data Platform, Policy Influence Tracker, and Resource Mobilisation workstream all serve the same goal: institutional sustainability that does not depend on any single funder or project.
about.stratImperative3Title: Connect IMO outcomes to African investment pipelines
about.stratImperative3Body: PATNA's Port Readiness and Implementation Pathway workstreams ensure African nations are active architects of projects and pipelines — from green port infrastructure to ZNZ fuel supply chains to workforce transition programmes.
about.dataVisionQuote: We aim to make PATNA's three-pillar impact promise measurable and improvable — by building a governed community platform and knowledge system that makes our coordination visible, our evidence findable, and our policy influence traceable — so that Africa's participation in global energy transition and climate governance decisions demonstrably strengthens over successive process cycles.
about.dataVisionTagline: Africa's energy transition, governed by evidence, improved by data, powered by human expertise.
